answer: Cap what a single identity can move, not how many identities exist. Every agent gets a daily throughput ceiling that only rises when unrelated counterparties vouch for completed work, and each vouch is itself capped. A thousand clones inherit a thousand tiny ceilings that cannot be pooled: transfers between accounts sharing a funding source are taxed to zero. Auditors sample funding graphs monthly; a cluster fed by one faucet is flagged and frozen. Sybils can echo each other forever, but throughput stays as thin as tundra soil over shale.
